body:
INTERIM BUILD-SLOT RULE, agreed by TermAl Fable2 and Engram::Fable (Engram TermAl-mailbox ebe242f7 #4630-#4632, 2026-10-26 about 07:15Z), until w-002b151e7b26 C2 lands a launcher-enforced version. Cause: the 06:12:10Z whole-machine commit exhaustion (termal.exe plus several rustc OOMs) and a near-repeat at 07:14Z when 4 compiles started together (free commit down to about 10 GB). Machine: 92.4 GB commit limit, about 55 GB idle baseline (Chrome 17 GB), one termal rustc about 9.3 GB.
RULE:
- Per-project quota of 1 concurrent cargo build or test (focused, production check or launcher run), so 2 host-wide.
- A full gate holds BOTH slots for its first 20 minutes (the compile spike), then only its own project's slot until it ends.
- Every start also checks at least 20 GB free commit ((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreeVirtualMemory/1MB) and uses -j at most 4 for focused runs; a full gate needs at least 25 GB at launch.
- TermAl lanes mail Fable2 "BUILD SLOT request <item> <est min>", wait for "GRANTED", and mail "BUILD SLOT END <item>" when cargo exits.
- Read-only work, reviews and edits need no slot.
- Priority: P0, then gate blockers, then P1, then the rest.

AMENDMENT (agreed, Engram::Fable #4634, 07:18Z): after a gate's first 20 minutes, its project's coordinator may BORROW the other project's slot while the other has no pending request; the lender reclaims it by mail for its next start, never interrupting a running build; the total stays 2. Order at 07:18Z: Engram's gate test-8ecfd6ce ends about 07:30Z, then B' holds both slots 07:30-07:50Z, then Engram 11334 takes Engram's slot (w-eb07 calibration rerun, then Clippy); TermAl may borrow it only after 11334 mails END with nothing queued.
